create_StaticManipulatorParams: create a StaticManipulatorParams config with arm joints, gripper joints, end-effector offsets, and motor gains
instantiate_StaticManipulator: instantiate a StaticManipulator with params, URDF path, and simulator for a fixed-base robot arm
reconfigure_StaticManipulator: reconfigure the StaticManipulator to load URDF and set initial joint states and motors
update_StaticManipulator: update the StaticManipulator to refresh camera transforms and check joint limits and sleep states
reset_StaticManipulator: reset the StaticManipulator joints and gripper motors back to their initial configuration
